pages: Preset mode shows only the Gifts you have chosen.

When you press [Add], the currently selected Gifts are included automatically.
You can also build a Preset from another Preset's code or file.
Click a Preset to apply, edit, share, or delete it.
Applying a Preset shows its Gifts and the Packs you need.

Editing selects the Preset's Gifts.
Select or deselect Gifts to change the Preset.
Use Share to send a Preset to someone or back it up.
The list shows a quick summary of each Preset's Gift counts.

A few sample Presets are provided the first time you open this.
We hope you find them useful.
